title: Austin Budget Deep Dive: Key Depts Present
summary:
*   A special meeting convened solely for a detailed worksession on the city's proposed 1988-89 operating budget.
*   Multiple critical departments presented their financial plans and proposals for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   Presenting departments included Planning and Development Management, Environmental Protection, Economic Development, and the Police Department.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
August 12, 1988 - 1:00 P.M. - SPECIAL CALLED MEETING Council Chambers, 307 V*sl Second
Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the
Council, noting the absence of Councilmember Carl-Mitchell and Mayor Pro Tern Shlpman.
Mayor Cobke announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a worksession on the Proposed
Operating Budget for FY 1988-89.
Four departments presented their budgets for the coming fiscal year. Hugh Standerfer and
Tracy Watson reviewed the budget for Planning and Development Management, which included
Office of Land Development Services, Planning and Growth Management, and Transportation
and Public Services Department.
Austin Llbrach represented the Environmental Protection Department. Representatives of
Economic Development and International Trade discussed their budget. Police Chief Jim
Everett led the budget discussion for the Police Department.
The meeting of the Council was adjourned at 5:30 P.M.
